add.user-input: D-01, atomic writes and an all or nothing build: build-templates emits two artefacts and phase two reads what phase one wrote, through a bare writeFileSync, so a crash leaves a state no commit represents
D-02, content addressed identity for conformance vectors, so a pin binds to the digest of its source rather than to the position E-01 and cannot migrate to another case
D-03, a generated and authored split at field level rather than only at file level, because the first human annotation on a generated store has nowhere to live
D-04, separating duplicate from conflicting, because same id with same content is idempotence and only same id with different content is a defect
D-05, an output diff across the corpus before the emitter changes, because glyph-diff compares two sources and nothing compares two emitter versions
